about: Richmond Hill is a suburban town in York Region, on the Oak Ridges Moraine north of Toronto. It grew from a Yonge Street village into a diverse, largely residential municipality. David Dunlap Observatory and extensive parkland sit among post-war and newer subdivisions. About 200,000 people live in Richmond Hill.
seoSummary: York Region town on the Oak Ridges Moraine, along the Yonge Street corridor.
